map.GN=40、ISO100、f/4：ISO100 距离 = GN/f = 40/4: GN=40, ISO100, f/4: ISO100 distance = GN/f = 40/4 = 10m; ISO400 factor 2 -> actual 20m, lights farther subjects.

map.距离和 ISO 什么关系？: How do distance and ISO relate?
map.有效距离随 √(ISO/100) 增；高 ISO 让闪光打得更远或可用更小光圈。: Effective distance grows with sqrt(ISO/100); high ISO throws flash farther or allows smaller aperture.
map.GN 固定时距离与光圈互锁，改其一必调另一，ISO 是第三变量三者联立。: With fixed GN, distance and aperture are locked together; change one and you must change the other, ISO is the third variable in the triad.
